name: agy-supervised-development
description: Codex-governed development with visible Chinese Sol plan summaries, Herdr as the sole AGY runtime, AGY as the primary writer, and Git-backed independent verification.

interface.shortDescription: Codex governs; Herdr runs; AGY builds; Git proves.
interface.longDescription: A serial supervised-development workflow. Codex owns Shape/Spec/Slice and the executable plan; before the first GPT-5.6 Sol High review Send it shows a concise Chinese plan and asks once; after review convergence it shows the final Chinese plan and continues automatically; every AGY execution then runs through Herdr; Codex independently reviews and verifies repository/runtime evidence before acceptance.
capabilities: Shape, specify, and slice executable plans
Show concise Chinese plans before and after Sol High review
Review executable plans with GPT-5.6 Sol High before implementation
Run every AGY writer through Herdr
Preserve Antigravity session identity through Herdr integration
Run Three-Axis Review and independent verification
Use Chrome DevTools MCP for applicable browser runtime verification
interface.defaultPrompt: Use AGY Supervised Development. Build a Codex-owned executable plan, show me a concise Chinese plan before the first Sol High Send and ask once, let later review rounds converge without repeated confirmation, show the final Chinese plan after review, freeze it, then run AGY only through Herdr and keep all review, verification, and acceptance Codex-owned.
